children: posted a sharp increase in August sales, extending a strong run of growth as demand for advanced computing chips continues to support its business,

Revenue reached NT$514.8 billion ($16.35 billion) during the month, marking a 53.3% increase from August 2025 and a 10.1% rise from July. Through the first eight months, sales totaled NT$3.39 trillion, up 39.3% from the same period last year.

The results add to a strong earnings backdrop for the chipmaker. Second-quarter profit rose more than 77% from a year earlier, while TSMC expects third-quarter revenue of $44.6 billion to $45.8 billion.

AI-related demand has also kept production lines busy. TrendForce data showed TSMC held a 72.5% share of the global foundry market in the second quarter, with its advanced 5-, 4- and 3-nanometer manufacturing capacity fully booked during the period.
Samsung Foundry ranked second with 5.9%, while SMIC held 5.4%, highlighting TSMC's lead in contract semiconductor manufacturing.

title: TSMC Revenue Jumps 53% on Red-Hot AI Chip Demand
